neighbours.label: 'as' in a wry negated comparison tacked on as an aside ('just not as pretty', 'only not as fast'), the deflating twist of a humorous remark; not a neutral or positive as-comparison
fire: Geese are basically swans, just not as graceful.
My homemade pizza is like the restaurant's, only not as edible.
The sequel has the same plot as the original, just not as funny.
Our office dog is a lot like a guard dog, just not as brave.
Decaf is coffee for people who want the taste, just not as much joy.
His new car is like a sports car, only not as fast or as shiny.
The remake looks like the 1980s film, just not as charming.
My garden is a lot like the botanical garden, just not as alive.
